scope: Mixed-precision CPU numerical prototype: float32 LU preconditioner and Krylov actions; float64 nonlinear state/residual and assembled Jacobian before casting. No physical equation shift, no GPU qualification.
protocol: Replace dense float64 pseudoinverse preconditioner with float32 partial-pivot LU of each owner-tuple diagonal block. Stabilize the PRECONDITIONER ONLY by sigma I, sigma=n*eps32*max(norm_inf(D32),tiny32); this is a dimension/roundoff-scale formula, not tuned physical compliance. Original operator, residual, Gamma and final criteria unchanged. Setup blocks still come from the float64 assembled Jacobian and are cast before LU; nonlinear outer state/residual still float64. Use unchanged mixed inexact method: original schedule,128shared Newton attempts,GMRES32x4/cap160, eight Armijo sizes, both starts, same final gates. Strict linear-screen failures remain reported; finite approximate directions accepted only by nonlinear Armijo. No factorization/shift/budget sweep. Require float32 factors/solves and finite output; save every shift and pivot failure.

from pathlib import Path
from scipy.linalg import lu_factor,lu_solve
import warnings
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
setup=(p.parent/'rain-continuation-float32/run.py').read_text().rsplit("source=(p.parent/'rain-projected-continuation/run.py')",1)[0]
setup=setup.replace("print('FLOAT32',audit32[-1],flush=True)","print('FLOAT32',audit32[-1],flush=True);return x.astype(float) if residual is not None and np.all(np.isfinite(x)) else None").replace('audit32.append(dict(lam=lam,','audit32.append(dict(arm=name,lam=lam,')
old="local=[(np.array(ii),np.linalg.pinv(D[np.ix_(ii,ii)],rcond=1e-12).astype(np.float32)) for ii in pre_groups.values()]"
new="""local=[]
 for ii in pre_groups.values():
  ii=np.array(ii);A=D[np.ix_(ii,ii)].astype(np.float32);sigma=np.float32(len(ii)*np.finfo(np.float32).eps*max(np.linalg.norm(A,np.inf),np.finfo(np.float32).tiny));A+=sigma*np.eye(len(ii),dtype=np.float32)
  with warnings.catch_warnings():
   warnings.simplefilter('error');factor=lu_factor(A)
  assert factor[0].dtype==np.float32 and np.all(np.isfinite(factor[0]));local.append((ii,factor));shifts.append(dict(arm=name,lam=lam,size=len(ii),sigma=float(sigma)))"""
assert old in setup;setup=setup.replace(old,new).replace('for ii,inv in local:out[ii]=inv@v[ii]','for ii,factor in local:out[ii]=lu_solve(factor,v[ii])')
shifts=[]
exec(compile(setup,str(p/'direction.py'),'exec'))
source=(p.parent/'rain-projected-continuation/run.py').read_text()
old="D=r.residual(y,True)+lam*r.E;delta,_,rank,_=np.linalg.lstsq(D,-F,rcond=1e-12);accepted=False"
new="""D=r.residual(y,True)+lam*r.E;delta=check32(y,lam,F,D);rank=-1;accepted=False
   if delta is None:termination='invalid-direction-or-action-cap';break"""
assert old in source;source=source.replace(old,new).replace('for step in range(16):','for step in range(128-len(history)):').replace("termination='stage-cap'","termination='global-cap'").split("if not all(v['status']=='reference-pass'")[0]
exec(compile(source,str(p/'nonlinear.py'),'exec'))
(p/'direction-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(records=audit32,shifts=shifts,linear_failures=sum(not v['linear_pass'] for v in audit32)),indent=2))
if not all(v['status']=='reference-pass' for v in results.values()):raise SystemExit(1)
